tokens.name: color-branco
tokens.usage: Page background (html, body) and text on color-vermelho or color-tinta fills. The site is white-first: there is no dark theme.

tokens.name: color-tinta
tokens.usage: Ink. All primary text and the two C's of the symbol, on color-branco (19.8:1) and color-superficie. Also the outline button's border and its hover fill.

tokens.name: color-vermelho
tokens.usage: The brand red: the two links of the symbol, the second word of the headline, the primary button fill and the focus ring. On color-branco it is 4.6:1 (passes for text); on color-superficie it is 4.22:1, so use it there only at 24px+ or for marks.

tokens.name: color-vermelho-escuro
tokens.usage: Hover state of the primary button (color-branco text on it: 5.9:1). Never a resting color.

tokens.name: color-cinza
tokens.usage: Secondary text: supporting paragraph, the note under the buttons, the loader label. 5.3:1 on color-branco, 4.86:1 on color-superficie.

tokens.name: color-linha
tokens.usage: Hairlines and dividers only (1.27:1 on white): never a control border or anything that must be seen to be used.

tokens.name: color-superficie
tokens.usage: A raised or set-apart surface (cards, panels) on the white page. Text on it: color-tinta or color-cinza.

styles.name: hero
styles.usage: The one-line hero headline. Fluid in code: min(10.4vw, 22vh), shown here at a 1440px viewport; min(20vw, 12vh) at line-height 0.9 on phones.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Section titles. Fluid in code: clamp(2.75rem, 1rem + 6vw, 7.5rem); this is the cap.

styles.name: promessa
styles.sample: Site, sistema e automação para a sua empresa parar de depender de você.
styles.usage: The h1 promise under the hero, max-width 31ch. Fluid: clamp(1.75rem, 3vw, 3rem).

styles.name: apoio
styles.sample: Cliente que te encontra no Google, pedido que cai sozinho na planilha.
styles.usage: Supporting paragraph under a promise, in color-cinza, max-width 46ch. Fluid: clamp(1rem, 1.25vw, 1.25rem).

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Direto com quem faz: eu, Zacarias.

styles.name: body-mobile
styles.sample: Direto com quem faz: eu, Zacarias.

styles.name: nota
styles.sample: Diagnóstico grátis · 2 minutos · resposta em até 24 h úteis
styles.usage: The info line under a call to action: cost, time, response. In color-cinza.

styles.name: etiqueta
styles.usage: Uppercase technical labels (the loader counter). Numbers use tabular figures.

tokens.name: btn-gap
tokens.usage: Gap between a button label and its icon; also between the loader's link mark and its text.

tokens.name: botoes-gap
tokens.usage: Gap between side-by-side buttons, and between the buttons and the note line (8px when stacked on phones).

tokens.name: gutter-min
tokens.usage: Page side gutter on small screens. The code's --gutter is clamp(20px, 4vw, 64px).

tokens.name: gutter-max
tokens.usage: Page side gutter on wide screens (upper bound of --gutter).
